highlights: Tap the speaker under an agent message to hear it read aloud with your reply voice.
Manage the server from the phone: providers and their accounts, custom providers, the ACP registry, browser profiles, agent folders and backup models.
Move a server with the new Transfer page, or import agents from a Grok Bot or Hermes Agent export.
The server Usage screen shows how much of each provider plan limit is left and when it resets.
The app reconnects within about 30 seconds after the server comes back, and keeps working when a server changes its key.
